products.name: You.com Enterprise
products.note: Private search AI; no tracking; enterprise deployment; data privacy focus

profile_text.body:
You.com is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as providing web search APIs designed for AI agents and large language models, with capabilities including web search, clean content extraction, and grounded answer generation.

The company offers two tracked products. The first is You.com itself, a search-augmented LLM available at its main website. The second is You.com Enterprise, described as a private search AI product aimed at business deployments, with an emphasis on data privacy and no user tracking. The site positions its search infrastructure around accuracy, freshness, and low latency for AI agent use cases.

The held facts note 161 legal exposure records associated with California, though no specific cases or litigation details are on file. You.com has no recorded MCP server presence and no SEC or patent filings noted in the available data.
